comment: get-doc topics intentionally NOT mirrored into api-reference/. app.ai, automation.ai, field.ai: their content depends on the runtime environment (AI model keys etc.). automation.api, automation.send-email, automation.trigger, integration.slack: they name credentials (the script runtime token, mailbox passwords, integration tokens), which the Claude plugin directory holds for review when a plugin also ships an MCP server. Agents call `teable get-doc --topic <t>` live for these.
